Recorded music under the score: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
=========================================================================

Both tracks are released by their authors under CC0 1.0, as stated on their OpenGameArt pages (checked 2026-10-19).
CC0 needs no credit; a courtesy credit is in docs/ASSETS.md.

CC0 deed (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): "The person who associated a work with this deed has
dedicated the work to the public domain by waiving all of his or her rights to the work worldwide under copyright law,
including all related and neighboring rights, to the extent allowed by law. You can copy, modify, distribute and perform
the work, even for commercial purposes, all without asking permission."

drunken_saloon.ogg
  "Drunken Saloon" by iamoneabe: a jazzy, bluesy, loopable noir bar tune.
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/drunken-saloon
  Licence: CC0 1.0
  Original: drunken_saloon.mp3 (320 kbps, 170.667 s; the measured pulse is about 90 bpm, 256 beats).
  Change:  re-encoded to Ogg Opus, 96 kbps, with no edit (same length to the sample, so it loops as the author made it).

determined_pursuit.ogg
  "Determined Pursuit (epic orchestra loop)" by Emma_MA: frantic strings, horns and drums, loopable.
  Source:  https://opengameart.org/content/determined-pursuit-epic-orchestra-loop
  Licence: CC0 1.0
  Original: determined_pursuit_loop.wav (16-bit stereo 44.1 kHz, 108.000 s).
  Change:  resampled to 48 kHz and re-encoded to Ogg Opus, 128 kbps, with no edit (same length to the sample).

Re-encoding: scripts/qa/musicEncode.mjs (WebCodecs Opus in headless Chrome, Ogg muxed by the script).
